title: Kissed with Cheese French Potatoes Tartiflette
description: A delicious, comforting, and easy-to-make French dish that combines the flavors of potatoes, cheese, and shio-koji. It's perfect for a lazy Sunday brunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: large potatoes
ingredients.notes: peeled and sliced into 1/2-inch thick rounds

instructions: Sauté the sliced potatoes in a large skillet with 2 tablespoons of butter until they're golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the potatoes to a 9x13-inch baking dish and sprinkle with half of the grated cheese, half of the chopped thyme, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Drizzle the rehydrated shio-koji over the potatoes, then sprinkle with the remaining cheese and thyme.
Dot the top of the potatoes with the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the top is golden brown.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
